ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agricultural workers, but it will accelerate monitoring and irrigation. Sensors, automated irrigation, and crop-protection drones speed up repetitive work, shifting roles from watering and spraying toward crop assessment, disease recognition, on-site care, and machinery coordination. Simple watering and harvesting tasks face pressure, while workers who understand agricultural timing and crop care become more valuable.

On-site crop care: people decide what to do.
Machinery coordination: people set the pace.
Agricultural timing: people understand the seasons.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate irrigation and crop protection, while people remain essential for judgment and crop care.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Watering and simple harvesting actions are vulnerable, not crop management. Workers who understand agricultural timing and manage crops become scarcer as productivity improves. Those who only water face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Entry requirements are low, but advancement depends on technical skills. Learn machinery and crop protection early. Pure watering is shrinking in the AI era, so develop crop-care judgment.
Progress from field labor toward managing a field and operating machinery. Learn sensors and crop protection and aim for a technician role.
Emphasize machinery and crop-protection experience and identify the crops you managed. Farms value reliability and knowledge of agricultural timing.
Do not hire based only on physical strength. Evaluate understanding of crop condition. Workers who can manage an entire field deserve higher daily pay.

病害辨识：叶斑靠人认。

农时把握：节气靠人记。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「浇水与简单采收」动作，不是「长势管护」的岗位。懂农时、能管护的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做浇水的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 77,300 personal and business property appraisers were employed in 2024. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: Direct answer: AI will not replace personal and business property appraisers, but it will sharply reduce time spent searching data, comparing cases, and drafting reports. The core work is on-site judgment and accountability for signed conclusions. AI cannot handle either responsibility because it does not answer for an incorrect value.
ai_s2_accel: Provenance and authenticity assistance: image recognition supports preliminary screening
Valuation model review: AI cross-checks human estimates and flags deviations
Regulatory and case updates: automated tracking highlights compliance changes
Client communication drafts: email and explanatory material preparation
ai_s2_auto: Market data research: AI retrieves auction records, sale prices, and comparable cases in seconds
Preliminary valuation: models estimate value from comparable items much faster than manual calculations
Report drafting: AI produces and formats template-based appraisal reports
Market briefs: AI automatically generates periodic price indexes and trend summaries
ai_s3_list: Physical inspection and experienced judgment. AI sees photographs; appraisers examine the object. Color differences, repair traces, and condition often become clear only through direct inspection.
Provenance and authentication responsibility. Value depends on authenticity, and appraisers remain accountable for incorrect conclusions.
Flexible application of valuation methods. Property varies widely, so people must choose the right method.
Writing for legal and insurance settings. Courts and insurers rely on appraisal reports, so every statement must withstand scrutiny.
Client trust and negotiation. A valuation affects a client's money and expectations, making direct communication essential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: The logic behind a 6/10 score is that data research, preliminary calculations, and report drafting are highly structured, so AI enters quickly. Physical judgment, accountability, and client communication resist standardization. This creates moderate exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI can handle routine work and free appraisers to focus on higher-value judgment and client relationships, provided they use the tools effectively.

ai_s5_persona.advice: Credentials and experience create the main entry barriers in appraisal. AI increases the premium on sound judgment, so new entrants should master authentication and valuation methods.
Use AI as an external market-research tool. Focus training on physical inspection and defending appraisal reports, then pursue advanced credentials.

Do more than submit resumes. Earn an assistant appraiser qualification and enter through a field you understand, such as art or machinery. Specialized knowledge is more effective than broad applications.
Shift selection criteria from system proficiency toward independent field inspection and accountability for signed conclusions. Give junior staff AI tools for cross-checking.

客户信任与谈判。一个数字背后是客户的钱和期望，沟通拿不走。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 评分 6/10 的逻辑：评估师一半工作（数据检索、初算、出稿）高度规则化，AI 进来快；另一半（现场判断、担责、沟通）没法标准化。所以是中等偏上的曝光分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为 AI 把杂活干完了，评估师能把时间腾给更有价值的判断和客户关系——前提是你愿意用这些工具。

ai_s5_persona.advice: 评估行业门槛在「证」和「经验」，AI 反而拉高了判断能力的溢价。想入行先把鉴定和估价方法论学扎实。
把 AI 当「行情外脑」用，重点练现场目验和报告抗辩能力，考更高等级的证。
别只投简历。考个助理评估师资质，用你懂行的领域（比如艺术品、机械）切入，比海投有用。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——初段设计被加速，但判断与现场还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「画标准图」动作，不是「把控安全」的岗位。有现场和经验的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做标准绘图的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 土木起步多练规范和现场，AI 时代纯画图在缩，早点练主设。
从「画详图」升级成「做方案 + 走现场」，学管理和注册，争取负责。
突出注册和项目，写清跟过哪些类型工程。
选人别只看软件，要看有没有现场判断。能保安全的人值得给高项目费。

ai_s7_trends: BIM 普及，初段工时缩。
城市更新与水利带来机会。
有现场经验的人更抢手。

body: 土木工程师规划设计并监督道路、桥梁、水务与建筑等基础设施，统筹结构、材料与规范，兼顾安全、成本与工期。
career_ai_description_block.heading: BIM 能自动建模，但荷载怎么算、规范怎么抠、现场怎么决，还是工程师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automation can run tests, but technologists still decide which results look suspicious, how to verify them, and how to communicate with clinicians.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Medical and Clinical Laboratory Technologists is projected to rise from about 351,200 in 2024 to 357,200 in 2034, a net increase of about 6,000 jobs, with around 22,600 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $61,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Medical and Clinical Laboratory Technologists, but it will reduce routine testing work. High-throughput instruments and AI interpretation accelerate standard tests. Technologists shift toward reviewing abnormalities, interpreting microscopy, managing quality control, and communicating with clinicians. Roles limited to data entry and report release face pressure, while strong interpretation skills gain value.
ai_s3_list: Abnormal-result interpretation: people judge what looks suspicious.
Microscopic identification: people provide experience.
Result verification: people retain accountability.
Quality-control judgment: people maintain stability.
Clinical communication: people understand context.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high AI exposure tier. Systems accelerate routine testing, while interpretation and verification still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces the act of running standard tests, not responsibility for the results. Technologists with strong interpretation skills become scarcer as productivity rises. Roles limited to entering and releasing results face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in medical laboratory science and practice both instrument operation and microscopy. Pure testing work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop interpretation skills early.
Advance from running tests to managing verification and a specialty section. Learn interpretation and quality control, then pursue responsibility for a section.
Highlight credentials and verification experience, and name the specialty sections where you have worked.
Evaluate candidates on verification skills, not only speed. Retain people who can safeguard results.

ai_s7_trends: Wider automation reduces routine testing work.
Specialty sections and result verification create opportunities.
Technologists with strong interpretation skills are in greater demand.

body: Medical and Clinical Laboratory Technologists process samples and perform biochemical, immunological, microbiological, and related tests. They verify and issue laboratory reports that provide accurate evidence for clinical diagnosis.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automation can run tests, but technologists still decide which results look suspicious, how to verify them, and how to communicate with clinicians.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动化能跑检测，但哪份结果可疑、怎么复核、怎么和临床沟通，还是技师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医学与临床实验室技师职业诊断在岗约 35.12 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 35.72 万人，净增约 0.60 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.19 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代检验技师，但会压缩常规检测。高通量仪器与 AI 判读把常规项目提速，技师从「跑标准检测」挪向「复核异常、判读镜下、管质控、和临床沟通」。真正被挤掉的是只做录入发单的人，有判读力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 异常判读：可疑靠人。
镜下识别：经验靠人。
结果复核：责任靠人。
质控把握：稳定靠人。
临床沟通：语境靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的检验区——常规检测被系统加速，但判读与复核还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑标准检测」动作，不是「结果把关」的岗位。有判读力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做录入发单的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学检验起步多练仪器和镜下，AI 时代纯检测在缩，早点练判读。
从「跑检测」升级成「管复核 + 专业组」，学判读和质控，争取负责。
突出资格和复核经验，写清跟过哪些专业组。
选人别只看速度，要看会不会复核。能把关的人值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化普及，常规检测缩。
专业组与复核带来机会。
有判读力的人更抢手。

body: 医学与临床实验室技师处理样本并完成生化、免疫与微生物等检测，核对出具检验报告，为临床诊断提供准确依据。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动化能跑检测，但哪份结果可疑、怎么复核、怎么和临床沟通，还是技师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can search regulations, review contracts, and screen risks, but Compliance Managers still decide whether the business can proceed and who accepts responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,333,700 Compliance Managers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,393,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 59,800 jobs, with about 106,700 openings per year. The 2026 median annual wage is about $136,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Compliance Managers, but it will change how they work. AI handles regulatory research, initial contract reviews, risk data screening, and policy document generation. Compliance Managers shift from reading files to making judgments and coordinating action. People remain essential for interpreting gray areas, driving cross-functional implementation, communicating with regulators, and accepting compliance responsibility. AI flags risk; people decide whether to accept it and how to answer regulators.
ai_s2_accel: AI anti-money laundering and transaction monitoring
Compliance knowledge bases and intelligent Q&A
ai_s2_auto: Initial contract and policy document review
Regulatory filing and policy template generation
ai_s3_list: Judgment in gray areas: people interpret situations that regulations do not resolve explicitly.
Cross-functional coordination: people drive implementation when business teams resist new controls.
Regulatory communication and response: experience guides on-site examinations and inquiries.
Compliance culture: policies and human influence encourage business teams to follow rules voluntarily.
Accountability: people sign compliance conclusions and face consequences when failures occur.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high exposure range. AI is rapidly automating document and screening work, including research, initial reviews, and data screening.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. As AI takes over screening, Compliance Managers need stronger judgment and coordination skills. Decisions in gray areas and communication with regulators become scarcer capabilities. Document-only compliance roles face pressure, while managers who understand RegTech and can implement policies earn a clear premium.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study law, finance, or auditing and add data-analysis coursework. Compliance careers gain value with experience, but entry standards are rising. Build relevant internships and certifications before graduation.
Become proficient with RegTech and data-analysis tools. Develop a specialty such as data compliance or anti-money laundering. Move from reviewing policies to managing compliance with technology.

Experience in legal work, auditing, or risk management transfers well into compliance. Start as a compliance specialist and pursue relevant certification. On your résumé, describe the policies you implemented and regulatory examinations you handled.

Do not hire Compliance Managers on certifications alone. Test judgment and the ability to drive action. People who use AI efficiently and still reach clear conclusions in gray areas form the core of a compliance team.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Identify risky clauses and compare reviews
Privacy impact assessments and compliance self-checks
Retain policy knowledge and answer questions intelligently
Scan risk points and issue alerts
Track policy execution and preserve audit trails

ai_s7_trends: RegTech and AI screening become standard. Document-only compliance roles shrink as Compliance Managers move toward judgment and coordination.
Demand surges in data compliance, anti-money laundering, and AI governance. Certified professionals with cross-functional skills earn a clear premium.
Tighter regulation shifts compliance from corrective action to preventive integration. Compliance Managers who understand the business become more valuable.

body: Compliance Managers build and operate organizational compliance management systems. Their work covers policies, risk identification, process reviews, regulatory engagement, and remediation to keep business activities within legal and regulatory requirements.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can search regulations, review contracts, and screen risks, but Compliance Managers still decide whether the business can proceed and who accepts responsibility.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你检索法规、审合同、筛风险，但「这个能不能做、要不要担这个责」，还得合规经理拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年合规经理在岗约 133.37 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 139.35 万人，净增约 5.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 10.67 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.65 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代合规经理，但会改变工作方式。法规检索、合同审查初筛、风险数据筛查、制度文档生成都被 AI 接手，合规经理从「翻文件的合规员」转向「判断与协调的合规管理者」。真正不可替代的是模糊地带的合规判断、跨部门的协调推动、与监管的沟通，以及合规责任本身——AI 能提示风险，但「接不接这个风险、怎么向监管交代」由人决定。
ai_s2_accel: AI 反洗钱与交易监控
合规知识库与智能问答
ai_s2_auto: 合同与制度文档审查初筛
报送材料与制度模板生成
ai_s3_list: 模糊地带的合规判断：法规没写死的地方，怎么拿捏分寸靠人。
跨部门协调推动：制度要落地，业务方不配合，怎么推靠人。
监管沟通与应对：监管现场检查、问询，怎么应对靠经验。
合规文化的塑造：让业务人员自觉守规，靠制度也靠影响力。
责任担当：合规结论由人签署，出了事追责的是人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业的文档与筛查工作正被快速自动化——检索、审查初筛、数据筛查都有 AI 代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。恰恰因为 AI 接管了筛查，合规经理被要求「更会判断、更会协调」，模糊地带的裁决和监管沟通反而更稀缺。真正被挤压的是纯文档型合规岗位，懂监管科技、能推动制度落地的复合型合规经理溢价明显。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读法学、金融或审计专业，辅修数据分析。合规是越做越值钱的职业，但入行门槛在提高，建议在校多积累实习和证书。
把监管科技、数据分析工具用熟，主动做数据合规、反洗钱等专业方向。从「审制度的合规员」升级为「懂监管科技的合规管理者」。
有法务、审计、风控背景的转行者优势明显，从合规专员切入。考取合规相关认证，简历上多写「推动过哪些制度、处理过哪些监管检查」。
招合规经理别只看证书，要看判断力和推动力。会用 AI 工具提效、又能在模糊地带给出清晰结论的人，是合规团队的骨干。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 风险条款识别、对比审查
隐私影响评估、合规自查

ai_s7_trends: 监管科技与 AI 筛查成为标配，纯文档型合规岗位收缩，合规经理向判断与协调型管理升级。
数据合规、反洗钱、AI 治理等专业方向需求爆发，持证复合型合规人才溢价明显。
监管持续趋严，合规从「事后整改」走向「事前嵌入」，懂业务的合规经理价值持续上升。

body: 合规经理负责企业合规管理体系的建设与运行，涵盖合规制度、风险识别、流程审查、监管对接与整改落实，确保业务活动符合法律法规与监管要求。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你检索法规、审合同、筛风险，但「这个能不能做、要不要担这个责」，还得合规经理拍板。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a flawless mix with one click, but only a DJ's ear knows what to play when the dance floor suddenly goes quiet.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 15,400 Disc Jockeys, Except Radio were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 16,000 by 2034. That represents about 600 additional jobs and roughly 1,500 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $44,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace DJs, but it will displace those who only play songs. Automated mixing, AI-assisted transitions, and playlist generation are already powerful enough for anyone to build a smooth set with software. Reading the room, driving the rhythm, interacting with the crowd, and improvising remain live human skills that algorithms cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI genre analysis to support track-selection strategy
Real-time audio analysis for monitoring beats and audience response
Cloud music libraries and copyright-compliance checks
AI streaming and traffic analytics for livestream platforms
ai_s2_auto: Automated playlist generation and intelligent recommendations
AI-powered automatic mixing and transitions with one-click beat matching
One-click audio normalization for loudness and EQ
Systematic management of performance schedules and business coordination
ai_s3_list: Reading the room: switch genres when the floor thins out and raise the energy at the peak, guided by experience and instinct.
Improvisation: recover within seconds from equipment failures, a flat crowd, or last-minute program changes.
Personal style and musical taste: the same songs sound different in the hands of different performers.
Connection with audiences and organizers: moving emotions, commanding the room, and rescuing a set depend on a human touch.
Long-term brand building: turn a strong reputation from repeated performances into a stable client base.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects the occupation's sizable share of desk-based work. Track selection, mixing, and audio processing are being rapidly absorbed by AI tools.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI makes mixing cheaper, shifting value toward live performance. DJs who can perform, stand out, and energize a crowd become more valuable, while the part-time market for simply playing songs with software is being squeezed.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If a child genuinely loves it, do not dismiss the interest or treat it as a guaranteed primary career. Start by taking it seriously as a side pursuit: practice the fundamentals, learn audio production, publish work online, and finish school. The people who reach the top build a body of work over time.

Treat AI mixing as a tool, not an opponent, and spend the saved time on crowd control and a distinctive style. Create original remixes and performance videos, then extend income into music production and event planning.

Build experience through warm-up and unpaid sets, and use a polished demo collection and live videos as a resume. Take wedding and corporate-event work for steadier cash flow instead of focusing only on nightclubs.

Do not select a DJ based only on play counts; a live trial is the best test. Someone who can command and rescue a room, brings equipment, and communicates reliably is a better resident DJ than a person with many followers who only records at home.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time mixing, transitions, and effects processing
Automatic beat matching and one-click normalization
Playlists by theme, mood, and energy
Cross-platform library synchronization and copyright checks
Distribution of performance clips and fan engagement

ai_s7_trends: Widespread AI mixing lowers the technical barrier, erasing the value of simply playing songs and making live control and personal style the core differentiators.
The performance economy and online livestreaming grow in parallel, taking DJs from nightclubs into weddings, music festivals, and virtual shows.
Personal branding and music-production skills command a clear premium, giving DJs who consistently release work a more stable income mix.

body: Disc Jockeys, Except Radio select, mix, and play music at performance venues, parties, and livestreams. They use rhythmic programming and live interaction to shape an event's atmosphere, combining music performance with event service.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate a flawless mix with one click, but only a DJ's ear knows what to play when the dance floor suddenly goes quiet.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一键生成完美混音，但舞池里突然冷场时该放哪首，只有 DJ 的耳朵知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年非电台唱片骑师在岗约 1.54 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.60 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.15 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.49 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代 DJ，但会淘汰「只会放歌」的那批。自动混音、AI 接歌、歌单生成已经很强，普通人靠软件也能排出流畅的歌单。剩下的读现场、带节奏、跟观众互动、临时应变，全是人在场的手艺，算法替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 曲风分析辅助选歌策略
实时音频分析帮你盯节拍与现场反馈
云端曲库与版权合规检测
直播平台的 AI 推流与流量分析
ai_s2_auto: 歌单自动生成与智能推荐
AI 自动混音与接歌（Beat Match 一键完成）
音频标准化处理：响度、EQ 一键修正
演出排期与商务对接的系统化管理
ai_s3_list: 读现场：舞池稀了换风格、High 点到了加把火，凭的是经验和直觉。
临时应变：设备故障、观众冷场、活动临时改流程，几秒内要兜住。
个人风格与音乐审美：同样的歌，放法不同就是两个人。
与观众和主办方的连接：调动情绪、控场救场，靠的是人味。
长期品牌经营：从一场场演出口碑里长出稳定的客源。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的案头工作占比不小——选歌、混音、音频处理，这些桌面活正被 AI 工具快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 让混音变便宜，反而把价值推向了「现场」：会做演出、有辨识度、能带气氛的 DJ 越来越值钱，纯靠软件播歌的兼职市场正在被挤掉。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果孩子真喜欢，别急着否定，也别当主业保底。先当副业认真投入：练基本功、学音频制作、发线上作品，同时把学业完成。真正能走到头部的人，是有作品沉淀的。
把 AI 混音当工具而不是对手，把省下的时间花在现场把控和个人风格上。多做原创 remix 和演出视频，往音乐制作、活动策划方向延伸收入。
从暖场和免费场攒起，录好 demo 集和现场视频当简历。多接婚礼和公司活动——那才是稳定现金流，别只盯着夜店。
选 DJ 别只看播放量，试一场现场最准。会控场、能救场、自带设备且沟通靠谱的，比粉丝多但只会在家录歌的更适合驻场。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 混音、接歌、效果器实时处理
按主题/情绪/能量出歌单
多平台曲库同步与版权检测
低延迟直播与观众互动
演出片段分发与粉丝运营

ai_s7_trends: AI 混音普及让技术门槛下降，「会放歌」价值归零，现场把控与个人风格成为核心壁垒。
演出经济与线上直播双轨发展，DJ 从夜店走向婚礼、音乐节与虚拟演出。
个人品牌与音乐制作能力溢价明显，能持续产出作品的 DJ 收入结构更稳。

body: 非电台唱片骑师在演出场所、派对和直播场景中选曲、混音、播放音乐，通过节奏编排与现场互动把控活动氛围，是介于音乐表演与活动服务之间的职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能一键生成完美混音，但舞池里突然冷场时该放哪首，只有 DJ 的耳朵知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A wearable can record steps and heart rate, but an Exercise Physiologist still decides how much a person should move, how to correct form, and how to motivate them when energy fades.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 23,900 Exercise physiologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 26,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,200 jobs, with about 1,700 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $58,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Exercise physiologists, and replacement risk is low. Wearables and AI recommendations can record data and provide templates, shifting the role from assessment and prescription toward individualized correction, guided adherence, and clinical judgment. Generic-template roles face pressure, while professionals who assess people and help them change habits become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Integrate health data from multiple sources
ai_s3_list: Assessment and prescription: people judge risk.
Movement correction: people observe posture.
Guided adherence: people build habits with clients.
Clinical judgment: people manage professional boundaries.
Goal balance: people make tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate exposure in a guidance-intensive occupation. Systems accelerate data and templates, while assessment and human guidance remain firmly with people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure also means low replacement risk. Systems replace generic templates, not individualized exercise prescriptions. People with assessment and coaching skills face little impact. Assistants who only distribute templates face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a bachelor's-level foundation in exercise science or rehabilitation and gain assessment and supervised-training experience while in school. Generic templates are shrinking in the AI era, so develop assessment skills early.
Move from providing templates toward assessment and guided adherence. Learn equipment and follow-up methods and seek responsibility for individual cases.
Highlight assessment and supervised-training experience, including the populations you have served. Organizations value steadiness and warmth.
Do not hire on credentials alone. Evaluate whether candidates can think through adherence. Core professionals who help people change habits merit performance incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Wearables become widespread, creating more complete data.
Integration of healthcare and exercise creates growth.
People with assessment and guidance skills remain more secure.

body: Exercise physiologists lead assessment and intervention for exercise and health. They coordinate fitness tests, prescriptions, and training, use equipment and assessment methods, create individualized exercise plans, and follow outcomes through implementation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: A wearable can record steps and heart rate, but an Exercise Physiologist still decides how much a person should move, how to correct form, and how to motivate them when energy fades.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 手环能记步数和心率，但哪个人该动多少、动作怎么纠、没劲时怎么鼓励，还是生理师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年运动生理学家在岗约 2.39 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.61 万人，净增约 0.22 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.82 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代运动生理学家，且替代风险低。可穿戴与 AI 建议能记数据和给模板，但生理师从「评估开方」挪向「个性化纠偏、陪伴执行、临床判断」。被挤掉的是只给通用模板的，有评估力能陪人改习惯的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 评估开方：风险靠人判。
动作纠偏：姿态靠人看。
陪伴执行：习惯靠人带。
临床判断：边界靠人握。
目标平衡：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的陪伴区——数据与模板被系统加速，但评估与陪伴还牢牢留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光也低风险：被替代的是「通用模板」动作，不是「个性化处方」的岗位。有评估力和陪伴力的人，几乎不受冲击。怕的是只会发模板的助理。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 运动人体/康复本科打底，在校多摸测评和带练。AI 时代纯模板在缩，早点练评估。
从「给模板」升级成「做评估 + 带执行」，学设备和随访，争取负责个案。
突出测评和带练经验，写清服务过哪些人群。机构看重稳和暖。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有陪伴脑子。能带人改习惯的骨干，值得给提成。

ai_s7_trends: 可穿戴普及，数据更全。
体医融合带来增量。
有评估陪伴力的人更稳。

body: 运动生理学家主导运动与健康的测评与干预，统筹体测、处方与训练，运用设备与评估手段，制定个性化运动方案并跟进成效落地。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 手环能记步数和心率，但哪个人该动多少、动作怎么纠、没劲时怎么鼓励，还是生理师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Scheduling systems can assign posts automatically, but supervisors still manage team emotions, on-site emergencies, and the judgment required for good service.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 609,600 frontline passenger service supervisors employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 632,200 by 2034, a net gain of about 22,600 jobs, with about 61,300 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $61,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace this career, but it will reduce administrative roles. Scheduling and workflow systems accelerate routine management, shifting people from forms and rosters toward team leadership, service control, and emergency response. Pure administrative coordination faces replacement. Leaders who can guide crews and respond under pressure are more resilient.
ai_s3_list: Team emotions: people lead the crew.
On-site emergencies: people adapt.
Service judgment: people read the situation.
Passengers with special needs: people provide care.
Team accountability: people take responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate exposure range for frontline management. Systems manage workflows, while people remain central to crew leadership and emergency response.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation replaces scheduling and paperwork tasks, not the role of leading a crew and taking responsibility. Supervisors with leadership judgment and emergency composure become scarcer as productivity rises. Those who only follow procedures and cannot lead people face greater pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start as a passenger attendant to build experience. Develop communication and leadership skills early because purely administrative work is shrinking in the AI era.
Advance from performing your own duties well to leading a crew and taking responsibility. Learn emergency response and service management.
Highlight experience and examples of crew leadership. Airlines value steady performance and resilience under pressure.
Do not assess candidates only by tenure. Look for leadership judgment and composure during emergencies.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service systems reduce entry-level roles.
Crew leadership and emergency response gain value.
Service management becomes more digital.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Passenger Attendants oversee cabin service crews. They coordinate schedules, training, service standards, and onboard emergency response to protect passenger experience and safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Scheduling systems can assign posts automatically, but supervisors still manage team emotions, on-site emergencies, and the judgment required for good service.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排班系统能自动派岗，但带人情绪、现场突发和服务分寸，还是主管的脑和嘴。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年一线主管乘客服务员在岗约 60.96 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 63.22 万人，净增约 2.26 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.19 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这一行，但会压缩事务岗。排班与流程系统把常规管理提速，人从「填表排班」挪向「带人、控服务、处突发」。真正被替的是纯事务协调，会带组能应急的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 带人情绪：组靠人带。
现场突发：应变靠人。
服务分寸：拿捏靠人。
特殊旅客：关怀靠人。
团队兜底：责任靠人担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的现场管理区——系统管流程，但带人和应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排班填表」动作，不是「带组兜底」的岗位。有带人脑子、能应急的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会走流程、带不动人的主管。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先入行做乘务攒资历，早练沟通和带人，AI 时代纯事务在缩。
从「自己干好」升级成「带组兜底」，学应急和服务管理。
突出资历和带组案例，航司看稳和抗压。
选人别只看资历，看有没有带人脑子和应急定力。

ai_s7_trends: 自助吃基础岗。
带组应急更被看重。
服务管理数字化。

body: 乘客服务员一线主管督导客舱服务班组，统筹排班、带训、服务标准执行与机上/车上突发处置，保障出行体验与安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 排班系统能自动派岗，但带人情绪、现场突发和服务分寸，还是主管的脑和嘴。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Equipment can press and bend glass, while skilled workers still control the feel of blowing and finish irregular openings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 41,700 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 44,300 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 2,600 jobs, with roughly 5,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $45,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers, but it will reduce standard tasks. Automated forming accelerates standard products and bent tubing, shifting workers toward custom blowing, edge finishing, and quality judgment. People limited to standard items face displacement, while those with strong tactile control and finishing skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Blowing feel: people judge heat and timing.
Custom forming: people apply experience.
Edge finishing and polishing: people handle fine work.
Defect judgment: people apply trained vision.
Emergency temperature adjustment: people react quickly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Equipment accelerates standard forming, while people retain responsibility for blowing and edge finishing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still carries risk. Automation replaces standard-item tasks rather than the craft of making custom forms attractive. Skilled workers with tactile control and finishing ability gain easier and more stable work as equipment spreads.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin as an apprentice and practice tactile control. Standard-item work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop custom blowing skills early.
Progress from following molds to custom blowing and edge finishing, aiming for a process craftsperson role.
Emphasize craft examples and finished products, clearly identifying the product categories you have made.
Do not evaluate candidates only by years of experience. Assess tactile control, and pay a premium for people who create attractive custom forms.

ai_s7_trends: Automated forming is spreading, reducing standard-item work.
Custom and artistic glass remain in demand.
Workers with strong tactile control are increasingly sought after.

body: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers operate high-temperature equipment to blow, shape, bend, and finish molten glass, ensuring dimensional accuracy and surface quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Equipment can press and bend glass, while skilled workers still control the feel of blowing and finish irregular openings.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 设备能压能弯，但吹制手感和异形修口，还是玻璃工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年玻璃吹制工、成型工、弯曲工、修整工在岗约 4.17 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.43 万人，净增约 0.26 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.57 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代玻璃工，但会压缩标准动作。自动化成型把标准件和弯管提速，玻璃工从照模挪向异形吹制、修口与质量判断。真正被挤掉的是只做标准件的，会手感能修整的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 吹制手感：火候靠人。
异形定形：经验靠人。
修口抛光：细活靠人。
缺陷判断：眼力靠人。
应急调温：反应靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的手艺区——标准成型被设备加速，但吹制和修口还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没风险：被替代的是标准件动作，不是把异形做漂亮的手艺。会手感、能修整的玻璃工，反而随设备普及更轻松也更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从学徒起多练手感，AI 时代标准件在缩，早点练异形吹制。
从照模升级成异形吹制加修口，争取工艺师傅。
突出手艺案例和成品，写清做过哪些品类。
选人别只看工龄，要看手感。能把异形做漂亮的人值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动成型普及，标准件缩。
异形与艺术玻璃仍刚需。
会手感的更抢手。

body: 玻璃吹制工、塑形工、弯曲工与修整工操作高温设备，对熔融玻璃进行吹制、成型、弯管与修口，保障玻璃制品的形状精度与表面质量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 设备能压能弯，但吹制手感和异形修口，还是玻璃工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can extract codes automatically, but people still decide how a medical record should be classified.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 194,800 Medical Records Specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 208,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 13,800 jobs, with around 14,200 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $50,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Medical Records Specialists, but it will take over automatic coding. Extraction and initial coding automate routine records, shifting specialists from template entry toward complex-record judgment, coding review, and compliance. Template-only workers face pressure, while reviewers remain stable.
ai_s3_list: Complex judgment: people determine classifications.
Coding review: people assess correctness.
Compliance: people protect the baseline.
Exception identification: people detect contradictions.
Accountability: people own data decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high AI exposure tier. Coding accelerates significantly, while review and compliance remain primarily human. The occupation is stable, but lower-skill tasks face pressure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Coding accelerates, not the occupation. Specialists who judge complex records and review coding remain stable, while algorithms absorb template entry.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in health information and practice classification systems. Pure entry is contracting, so learn review early.
Advance from template entry to record judgment and quality control, learn compliance, and pursue health-information supervision.
Highlight coding and quality-control experience and identify systems used. Credentials are preferred.
When hiring, look beyond entry skills and assess review and compliance. Gatekeepers deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Automatic coding spreads and accelerates entry.
Coding review and compliance become core abilities.
Professionals who safeguard quality remain stable.

body: Medical Records Specialists manage health-information collection, coding, and quality control, converting care into standardized data that supports insurance settlement, quality statistics, and research.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can extract codes automatically, but people still decide how a medical record should be classified.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动抽码，但那条病历到底该归哪类，还得人判。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年病历记录专员在岗约 19.48 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 20.86 万人，净增约 1.38 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.42 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.03 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代信息技师，但会接手自动编码。抽取与初编码把常规病历自动化，技师的时间从「录模板」挪向「复杂病历判断、编码审核与合规把关」。真正被挤掉的是只录模板的人，能审能控的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 复杂判断：归类靠人定。
编码审核：对错靠人评。
合规把关：底线靠人守。
异常甄别：矛盾靠人察。
责任归属：数据现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——编码被明显加速，但审核与合规仍主要靠人，岗位稳但低技能环节承压。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被加速的是「编码」，不是「岗位」。会判复杂病历、能审编码的人更稳，只录模板的人会被算法接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学信息打底，在校多练分类与系统。AI 时代纯录在缩，早点练审核。
从「录模板」升级成「判病历 + 质控」，学合规，争取往信息主管走。
突出编码与质控经历，写清跟过哪些系统。有资质优先。
招人别只看会录，要看审核和合规。能把关的人值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 自动编码普及，录入提速。
编码审核与合制成核心能力。
能把关的人更稳。

body: 病历记录专员是病历记录与信息技师管理健康信息的采集、编码与质控，运用标准分类系统把诊疗转成可统计的数据，支撑医保结算、质量统计与科研。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动抽码，但那条病历到底该归哪类，还得人判。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote control can read gauges automatically, but operators still judge downhole abnormalities and decide how to handle equipment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 45,200 oil and gas service unit operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 45,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with about 4,100 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $58,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace service unit operators, but it will reduce routine watchkeeping. Automated monitoring and remote control accelerate gauge reading, shifting operators from watching instruments toward diagnosing abnormalities, handling equipment, and protecting safety. People who only record readings face displacement, while capable safety-focused responders become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Downhole judgment: people assess abnormalities.
Equipment response: people repair failures.
Safety control: people manage risks.
On-site coordination: people align operations.
Emergency capability: people handle incidents.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in a high-risk field with moderately high AI exposure. Monitoring is accelerating, but people remain essential for on-site response and safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces gauge-reading watch duties, not safe incident response. People who handle equipment and protect safety become scarcer as efficiency rises. Operators who only watch screens face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start with petroleum or electromechanical training and practice equipment and procedures. Pure watchkeeping is shrinking in the AI era, so develop response skills early.
Advance from watching gauges to diagnosing abnormalities + protecting safety and learn remote-control data.
Highlight wellsite experience and certifications and list the operations you have supported. Field employers value composure and decisiveness.
Do not select people only by strength; assess safety judgment. Core responders merit high allowances.

ai_s7_trends: Remote control is spreading and watchkeeping is shrinking
Safety response receives greater emphasis
Unconventional production supports jobs

body: Oil and gas service unit operators run specialized fracturing and cementing equipment, monitor pressure, flow, and proppant, coordinate with drillers, and protect safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Remote control can read gauges automatically, but operators still judge downhole abnormalities and decide how to handle equipment.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 远控能自动读表，但井下异常怎么判、设备怎么处置，还是操作员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作员、石油天然气在岗约 4.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.54 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.41 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.80 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代服务设备操作员，但会压缩值守。自动监测与远控把常规读表提速，操作员从「盯表」挪向「判异常、处置设备、保安全」。真正被挤掉的是只抄表的，有处置力能保安全的更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 井下判断：异常靠人判。
设备处置：故障靠人修。
安全把关：风险靠人控。
现场协同：配合靠人对。
应急能力：突发靠人处。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的高危区——监测被加速，但现场处置和安全还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「抄表值守」动作，不是「保安全处置」的岗位。有处置力、能保安全的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看屏的操作员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 石油/机电起步多练设备和规程，AI 时代纯值守在缩，早点练处置。
从「盯表」升级成「判异常 + 保安全」，学远控数据。
突出井场和证书，写清跟过哪些作业。现场看重稳和狠。
选人别只看体力，要看有没有安全脑子。能处置的骨干值得给高补贴。

ai_s7_trends: 远控普及，值守缩
安全处置更被看重
非常规增产留岗

body: 石油天然气服务设备操作员操作压裂与固井等特种作业设备，监控压力流量与加砂，配合司钻完成井下作业并保障安全。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 远控能自动读表，但井下异常怎么判、设备怎么处置，还是操作员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the mix precisely, but an experienced craftsperson still has to feel the material and decide when the slurry is ready for grinding.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,500 terrazzo workers and finishers were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 1,300 by 2034, a net loss of about 200 jobs. The occupation generates roughly 100 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $57,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace terrazzo workers, but it will change material mixing and scheduling. Mix ratios once relied on experience; software can now recommend ratios based on aggregate, cement, and climate and automatically schedule work. AI also assists with pattern design. Yet machines cannot perform the on-site work of placing, grinding, and polishing. A person must guide the grinder and judge when the material is ready to be ground.
ai_s2_accel: AI surface inspection: computer vision detects pinholes and color variations
Automated grinding robots: grind large floor areas automatically
Digital showrooms: preview terrazzo patterns in VR
Material supply chain management: intelligently schedules aggregate and binder inventory
ai_s2_auto: Mix-ratio calculation software: recommends the optimal mix for materials and climate
Pattern layout design: computer-assisted joint and pattern design for terrazzo
Project scheduling management: automates schedules for progress, materials, and personnel
Automated grinding equipment: grinders operate with preset parameters
ai_s3_list: The feel for placing and leveling: slurry consistency, thickness, and compaction depend on touch.
Judging when to grind: experience determines the right moisture and hardness, separating good work from poor work.
Pattern joint craftsmanship: machines cannot replace the skill needed to divide and align complex patterns.
Finished-surface repair: filling pinholes and correcting color differences require patience and aesthetic judgment.
Site coordination and safety: coordinating multiple processes on large projects while protecting against dust exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects that most of this work happens beside wet slurry and grinding machines. Software is taking over desk-based tasks such as mix calculations and scheduling, but AI offers limited help with the hands-on work of placing, grinding, and polishing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. What is losing its distinct value is basic placement work, as precast panels and automated grinding absorb some simpler tasks. Complex patterns, premium craftsmanship, and finish repair still require experienced workers who can execute on site. As AI improves, craftspeople who read drawings and deliver complex work become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A university degree is unnecessary for entry. Vocational study in architectural decoration technology or building materials combined with an apprenticeship is a strong route. Focus on developing touch and drawing-reading skills, and earn safety certifications. In the AI era, workers skilled in complex patterns and new flooring materials are more competitive.

Do not limit yourself to basic placement. Build skills in drawing interpretation, pattern design, and new material processes, advancing from floor grinder to flooring craft specialist. Take occupational health protection seriously because dust exposure and physical strain are the most immediate career risks.

Begin as an apprentice, first learning mix ratios and basic placement. On your resume, quantified results such as completed floor area and number of complex-pattern projects are more useful than vague claims about working hard.

Do not hire only for physical strength. Look for breadth of craft skills and responsibility. A worker who can independently lead placement and grinding crews, execute complex patterns, and follow safety practices is worth retaining at higher pay than someone limited to basic tasks.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Recommend ratios based on materials and climate
Computer vision for pinholes and color variations
Coarse grinding, fine grinding, and polishing
Dust removal, personal protection, and health monitoring

ai_s7_trends: Design trends are reviving terrazzo floors, keeping demand stable in public buildings and commercial spaces and creating clear premiums for high-end pattern work.
Factory-made precast terrazzo panels and automated grinding equipment are diverting basic work, while cast-in-place projects shift toward complex patterns and detailed finishing.
Terrazzo workers are evolving into drawing-literate flooring craft specialists, and workers who understand new materials and equipment are increasingly valued.

body: Terrazzo workers and finishers prepare materials, place terrazzo, grind and polish surfaces, and finish completed floors. They combine aggregate with binders to create durable, attractive floor finishes and represent one of the more technically demanding flooring trades in architectural decoration.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the mix precisely, but an experienced craftsperson still has to feel the material and decide when the slurry is ready for grinding.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把配比算得精准，但研磨时机——那层浆料几成熟开始磨，还得靠师傅的手去试。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人修整工在岗约 0.15 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.13 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.73 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代水磨石工人，但会改变「配料和排期」这件事。以前配比靠经验，现在有软件按骨料、水泥和气候推荐配比，自动排工期；图案设计也有 AI 辅助。可摊铺、研磨、抛光这些现场活，机器做不了——磨光机得有人推，几成熟开始磨，得有人判断。
ai_s2_accel: AI 表面检测：图像识别发现气孔与色差
自动研磨机器人：大面积地面自动打磨
数字样板间：VR 预览水磨石图案效果
材料供应链管理：骨料、胶结料库存智能调度
ai_s2_auto: 配比计算软件：按材料与气候推荐最优配比
图案排版设计：电脑辅助水磨石图案分缝设计
工程排期管理：进度、材料、人员排期自动化
研磨设备自动化：磨光机按预设参数作业
ai_s3_list: 摊铺与找平的手感：浆料的稠度、厚度、压实程度，靠手上的感觉。
研磨时机的判断：什么湿度、什么硬度开始磨，经验就是质量分水岭。
图案分缝的工艺：复杂图案怎么分缝、怎么对齐，机器替代不了。
成品修复的手艺：气孔怎么补、色差怎么调，师傅的耐心和审美。
现场协调与安全：大面积工程的多工序衔接，和自身粉尘防护。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分工作在湿乎乎的浆料和磨光机旁边——配比、排期这些桌面活正被软件接管，但摊铺、研磨、抛光这些现场手艺，AI 帮不上太多忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。真正被压缩的是「纯基础摊铺」的不可替代性——预制板和自动研磨分走一部分简单活，可复杂图案、高端工艺、成品修整这些环节，AI 越强越需要能落地的老师傅去执行。会看图纸、能做复杂工艺的师傅反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想入行不必读大学，职校的建筑装饰技术、建材类专业加学徒实践是好路线。重点练手感和看图，顺带把安全证书考了。AI 时代，会做复杂图案、懂新型地面材料的师傅更吃香。
别只会基础摊铺。把图纸识读、图案设计、新型材料工艺补起来，从「纯磨地工人」往「地面工艺师」走。注意职业健康防护，粉尘劳损是最真实的职业风险。
从跟师傅当学徒开始，先学配比和基础摊铺。简历上写「完成地面面积、复杂图案项目数」这类可量化成果，比空喊能吃苦有用。
招人别只看力气，要看工艺广度和责任心。能独立带摊铺研磨班组、会复杂图案工艺、懂安全防护的师傅，比只会干基础活的更值得高薪留。

ai_s7_trends: 设计审美让水磨石地面回潮，公共建筑与商业空间需求稳定，高端图案工艺溢价明显。
工厂预制水磨石板与自动研磨设备分流基础活，现场浇筑转向复杂图案与精修环节。
水磨石工人角色升级为「会看图的地面工艺师」，懂新型材料与设备的师傅更吃香。

body: 水磨石工人与修整工负责水磨石地面的材料配制、摊铺施工、研磨抛光和成品修整，把骨料与胶结料结合成耐磨、美观的地面饰面，是建筑装饰行业里技术门槛较高的地面工种。
